email.subject: Core Works Fitness: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I checked Core Works Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button. Most people search for a gym on their phone and want to call right away — without a tap-to-call, a lot of them just move to the next result.

I also noticed heavy images slowing load time and no reviews shown, which can lose a bit more trust at the margins.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's losing you visits, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
